deskRailWaitsForTor: 等 Tor 连接后再连接。
deskRailPaymentsWait: 付款暂存在 Epicbox 服务器上。
deskRailOpenEpicbox: 打开 Epicbox 接收设置
deskRailPortInternet: 端口 {port} · 可从互联网访问
deskRailOpenHttp: 打开 直连 · HTTP 接收设置
deskAppNodeSyncedBody: 本地节点已拥有完整的区块链，现在可以使用。应用将重启以切换到本地节点。
deskAppFirstScanBody: 钱包正在区块链中查找属于它的输出。期间钱包仍可使用；扫描完成后余额会更新。
deskShellNotQuitBody: 正在发送一笔付款。发送完成后再退出。
deskShellLockedBody: 连接钱包核心后，“退出”才会关闭应用。
deskTourOverviewText: 余额和仍在确认中的金额，下面是最近的交易。其他功能都在侧边栏中。
deskTourSendText: Pay an Epicbox address, or make a transaction file for someone to sign. A review comes before anything leaves.
deskTourReceiveText: This wallet’s Epicbox address: share it to be paid. Transaction files to sign or finalize are below it.
deskTourInvoicesText: 支付别人发来的账单，或向欠你钱的人开具账单。用标签页在两者之间切换。
deskTourActivityText: 每笔交易的进度和详情。侧边栏此项上的数字表示有事项等待你处理。
deskTourContactsText: Saved addresses by name. Send picks from here.
deskTourNodeText: Which node the wallet reads the chain from. The other settings pages are listed on the left.
deskTourHelpText: Topics by section and Report a problem. More on every page is here, and this tour can be shown again.
deskTourAdvancedText: Tor-only mode, outputs and technical details live here. Switch on what you need.
